entries.0b938de7402ba084: It has a single segment, the chemical pump business. By region, revenue was ¥22,568 million in Japan, ¥7,849 million in the United States, ¥6,096 million in Europe and ¥5,790 million in China. There is no specific customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
